title: Oxidation–reduction and electrochemical cells
summary: Oxidation numbers and balancing redox equations by half-reactions in acidic and basic solution; galvanic cells and cell notation; standard electrode potentials and the spontaneity of redox reactions; ΔG° = −nFE°, E° and K, and the Nernst equation; chemical and biological oxidations.

OpenStax 4.2 Classifying Chemical Reactions (oxidation numbers, half-reaction method) and 17.1 Review of Redox Chemistry.
OpenStax 17.2 Galvanic Cells, 17.3 Electrode and Cell Potentials, 17.4 Potential, Free Energy, and Equilibrium.
